description: A budget.remove whose confirm digest does not match the statement the daemon renders from the row AS IT IS NOW: the row moved between the read and the commit (or the client computed against a stale read), and the act is refused rather than silently loosened. data.kind is confirm-mismatch, and the refusal carries the current statement and its correct digest (the S45 PM7.1 pattern: a commit is bound to what was read) — the remedy is one re-read, not a guess.

data.what: budget remove refused: the digest does not match the statement rendered from the row as it is now (it moved since you read it) — read it again and remove with the new digest
data.means: the daemon understood and declined — no budget row was written and nothing moved
